summary: Focused verification of the MOCK -> REAL (Resend) email verification switch. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases passed (register contract, anti-fraud disposable/duplicate, verify-email negative paths, login + /me regression). Frontend: register flow reaches verify step with no MOCK banner; amber 'couldn't confirm delivery' banner shown for example.com (email_sent=false, expected in Resend test mode); emerald green banner branch validated by stubbing email_sent=true; invalid code shows 'Invalid verification code' toast; login regression lands on /workspace with credit-balance (138 credits) and studio-status-pill rendering. No AI prompts executed.
critical_code_review_comments: Cosmetic: /app/backend/routers/auth.py module docstring still says 'mock email verification' - update to reflect real Resend delivery.

Optional hardening: register returns 200 even when send_verification_email() fails (email_sent=false) and the user is left unverified with no resend endpoint. Consider adding POST /api/auth/resend-code so users can recover from a delivery failure.

email_service.py assumes resend.Emails.send returns a dict; if the SDK returns an object, res.get('id') would raise inside the try and be logged as a failure (returning False despite a successful send). Low risk but worth a defensive getattr.
seed_data_creation: Created 3 throwaway TEST_it5_*/TEST_ui5_* users at example.com; all deleted from MongoDB after the run (verified deletions).
test_credentials: test@guiblox.com / Test1234! (seeded, verified). test_credentials.md note updated: verification is no longer mocked.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Email verification happy path CANNOT be automated (code only in email; Resend test mode delivers only to the account owner mesatylm10@gmail.com). To test verify success, read verification_code directly from Mongo users collection. Register is capped at 2 signups per IP/24h and rate-limited 5/min on auth paths - conftest.new_session(rand_ip()) sets a unique X-Forwarded-For per request family. Do not run AI workspace prompts (real cost).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no defects found. email_sent=false for example.com recipients is Resend test-mode recipient restriction, not an application bug.
